summary: adapter enforces stateless backend and forbids shell registry; prepare requires declared slice plus contract_hash/validator_hash and mandatory skill-input receipt gate; lifecycle strictly red→green→refactor with scoped paths and exit/failure proofs; completion yields non-authoritative implementation-candidate and never authorizes acceptance/handoff/release; resume rejects identity drift and terminal stale states; stage bindings require bundle v1, exactly one context/attempt, STAGE-* IDs, matching plan/slice/run/attempt, and empty authorizes; protocol persistence rejects incomplete, escaping, reparse, conflicting, or undeclared artifacts and preserves named observation files; execute requires a new run directory, paired protocol bundle/store, persists recovery-state v1 with hashes, stages, empty authorizes, and optional skill-input hashes; key diagnostics: RMAP-PREPARE-INVALID, RMAP-CMD-SHELL, RMAP-HASH-AUTHORITY, RMAP-TDD-RED-NOT-OBSERVED, RMAP-TDD-IMPLEMENTATION-BEFORE-RED, RMAP-TDD-EXIT-PROOF, RMAP-RECOVERY-NEW-RUN-STATE
